title: Roswell material as seed for an exotic alloy R&D program at Wright-Patterson
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Roswell material as seed for an exotic alloy R&D program at Wright-Patterson, about 1947-present at Air Force Research Lab, Wright-Patterson AFB, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Air Force Research Lab, Wright-Patterson AFB

tellings.quote: The theory goes that whatever was recovered at Roswell eventually became a classified R&D seed program at Wright Patterson's Air Force Research Lab.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a theory that whatever was recovered from the 1947 crash near Roswell, New Mexico, became the seed of a secret research programme. According to the theory, the material ended up at the Air Force Research Lab at Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio, where it fed long-running work on exotic metals. If true, it would mean the recovered material shaped secret technology research for decades.
